name: Search and scan
flow: type part of a tag or pen

notes.purpose: Find a pig in any unit of the section by part of her ear tag or her pen, from Toolbox.
states: Empty field: nothing is listed, only the hint
Typed: results grouped by unit (Find a pig · results)
Nothing matches (Find a pig · no match)

elements.name: Search field
elements.shows: A full-height white page (the status bar turns white with it). The field is pinned and focused: the search icon, the typed text, ✕ once something is typed, the scan icon and Cancel.
elements.rule: Cancel returns to Toolbox; the scan icon opens Scan ear tags.

copy: (raw) Type part of an ear tag or a pen, or scan a tag. Searches every unit.
rules: Owner decision 2026-10-12: search is global (every unit), nothing is listed until something is typed, and a result opens that animal in the current context. One card per unit under a plain "Unit 7" heading, this unit first (owner, 2026-10-20).
Drawn by the design system's Lookup (components/Lookup), the same page as Farrowing's.
Replaces the Find a pig or pen drawer (a form with Search that matched whole tags only and opened the task, not the pig).

controls.does: opens her pig record (the Inspection pig record, embedded over the device); its Back returns here with the text kept

notes.purpose: Show every pig of the section that matches what is typed, the unit the worker is in first.
states: Matches in one unit or several: one card per unit

elements.name: Results
elements.shows: One tinted card per unit under its plain heading. Each row is the tag, the typed part bold and the rest muted, over her pen, with her marked condition on the right when she has one (the generic row: Home is not a task).
elements.logic: Tags that start with the typed text come first, then tags that contain it, then a pen that matches. The unit the worker is in leads.

notes.purpose: Say that nothing matches, in every unit.

elements.name: No-match line
elements.shows: One quiet line quoting what was typed.
elements.rule: The field keeps focus and ✕ is shown, so the worker corrects the number at once.

elements.name: Empty line
elements.at: Hold the reader to an ear tag
elements.shows: A scan icon, "Hold the reader to an ear tag" and "Each pig you scan is ticked here."
elements.rule: The first scan replaces it with the list; stopped before any scan, it reads "Scanning is stopped".

edge: The prototype has no reader: "Simulate scan" beside the phone reads the next sample pig. ?scan=list, ?scan=ticked and ?scan=none open the page with sample scans, ticks, or no reader.
rules: Owner decision 2026-10-12: the scanner always listens; each scan adds the animal to a list, newest first; a repeat scan lights her row; every row has its tick box and ticks are for bulk. elements.rule: Scanning starts by itself once a reader connects; there is nothing to tap.

elements.name: Scan list
elements.shows: A tick box (ticked as she was read), the tag over her pen, and her marked condition on the right when she has one (as To treat and Monitoring draw it), then the door to her record. The rows are drawn exactly as before the change; only the ticking is new.
elements.logic: Newest scan first within its unit; a repeat scan adds no second row and lights hers again.
